title: मध्यकालीन नेपालमा सुरक्षा व्यवस्था र युद्धकलासम्बन्धी शिक्षादीक्षा Madhyakalin Nepalma Surakshya Byabastha  ra Yuddhakala Sambandhi Shikshyadeekshya
nepali: ज्ञानको अभिवृद्धि, जीविकोपार्जन तथा विविध आवश्यकताहरूका निमित्तशिक्षादीक्षा लिने दिने चलन प्राचीन युगदेखि नै चलेको हो । युद्ध आक्रमण जस्ता घटनाहरूबढी हुन थालेपछि सैन्य शक्ति बढाउनुपर्ने वाध्यात्मक परिस्थिति त्यसबेला थियो । त्यसैलेशिक्षादीक्षाका विषयहरूमा युद्धकलाको ज्ञान जस्ता क्षेत्रको महइभ्व बढ्दै जान थाल्यो ।सुरक्षित बसोवासको व्यवस्थादेखि लिएर युद्धकलाको ज्ञान हासिल गर्न समेत रज्यले नैप्रोत्साहित गर्ने पनि गर्दथ्यो । राज्यले सैन्य आपूर्ति गर्न नसक्ने अवस्थामा जनता स्वयंजनसेनाका रूपमा उठ्नुपर्ने वाध्यात्मक अवस्था रहेको हुँदा युद्धकलासम्बन्धी केही न केहीशिक्षादीक्षा त्यतिबेला सबैका लागि अपरिहार्य जस्तै बनेको थियो ।
american_english: For the growth of knowledge, the earning of a livelihood and various other needs, the practice of receiving and giving education has been going on since ancient times. Once events such as wars and invasions began to grow more frequent, there was a compulsion at that time to increase military strength. Consequently, among the subjects of education, the importance of areas such as the knowledge of the art of war began to grow. Right from arrangements for a secure place to live, the state itself used to encourage people even to acquire knowledge of the art of war. Because there was a compulsory situation in which, when the state could not supply the military, the people themselves had to rise as a people's army, some form of education concerning the art of war had become practically unavoidable for everyone at that time.
british_english: The practice of receiving and imparting education, in order to further knowledge, earn a livelihood and meet a variety of needs, has been in existence since ancient times. When events such as wars and invasions began to multiply, the situation at that time compelled an increase in military strength. It therefore followed that, among the subjects of education, the importance of fields such as the knowledge of the art of war began to grow. From the arrangement of a secure habitation onwards, the state itself would also encourage the acquisition of knowledge of the art of war. Since a situation prevailed in which the public were obliged to rise as a people's army whenever the state was unable to supply the military, some form of education relating to the art of war had become, at that time, virtually indispensable for all.
australian_english: The practice of getting and giving an education for growing knowledge, making a living and meeting all sorts of needs has been around since ancient times. Once things like wars and invasions started happening more often, there was real pressure back then to build up military strength. So among the subjects taught in education, the importance of areas like knowing the art of war started to grow. Starting from setting up a secure place to live, the state itself used to encourage people to learn about the art of war as well. Because there was a situation where the people themselves had to step up as a people's army when the state could not supply the troops, some sort of education about the art of war had become pretty much essential for everyone at that time.
informal_english: People have been getting and giving education since ancient times, all to grow knowledge, make a living and cover a load of needs. Once wars and invasions started happening more and more, there was real pressure back then to build up military muscle. So among the subjects covered in education, stuff like knowing the art of war started to matter more and more. From sorting out a safe place to live, the state itself even used to push people to pick up knowledge of the art of war. Because there was a situation where the people themselves had to step up as a people's army when the state could not supply the troops, some kind of education about the art of war had basically become a must for everyone at that point.
translator_notes: 'शिक्षादीक्षा' rendered as 'education'; its nuance of formal initiation is flattened. Sentence order preserved.
